panels.description: Colorado constructed wetland and downstream channel. Water is visibly clearer, but the inlet gate is nearly closed and the system looks finite. Leave upper-left for a location caption and lower-left for the clarity metric.

A survey tray holds aquatic invertebrates beside a monitor showing a dated pilot survey and increased count. A separate warning marks finite wetland capacity. Leave upper-right for the survey metric and lower-right for the warning.
A wall screen shows Croft beside his son's treatment schedule. The son appears only as a pale hand beneath hospital bedding behind a privacy partition. Leave upper-left for Croft's dialogue.
Back in Nexus, Sitara and Roman watch the recording, divided by the archive case. Leave upper-left for Croft's final dialogue.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You want to stop the work that made this possible.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You knew it was useful. You knew it was controlled. Why is it wrong only now?
